content:
Last month, Anthropic announced plans to expand Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad, with the rollout beginning first in Anthropic's most expensive paid plan.

As of today, Anthropic says Claude Cowork has been fully rolled out to mobile and desktop versions across all paid plans.

For more information about the release of the mobile version of Claude Cowork from Anthropic, please click here to view.

Meanwhile, OpenAI has also launched its own solution, called ChatGPT Work, which is also available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.

Make the most of your Apple products.
